notes.text: The genre prior 'Hip-hop' only sets the initial weights and target ranges of the objective (practice level); measured references and user settings always take precedence

objective_breakdown.note: Each penalty is 0 inside the target range and approaches 1 the further it is outside. The score is the sum of effective weight x penalty; 0 is ideal. Weights of terms that cannot be measured are redistributed proportionally to the measured terms of the same objective and recorded
